message.content:
Second independent check — is this M13 finding a REAL, actionable issue to fix before merge? Read the code; be skeptical; confirm only with a concrete pointer.
File:components/admin/AdminActivityTables.tsx (SESSION_TONE / PAYMENT_TONE / PAYOUT_TONE maps + the status column render() calls (label={r.status}))
Admin activity tables render raw DB status strings as user-facing labels (bypasses i18n, inconsistent with every other table)
The three status columns render the raw database enum value directly: `render: (r) => <Badge tone={SESSION_TONE[r.status] ?? "neutral"} label={r.status} />`. So users see developer-facing strings like "in_progress", "captured", "authorized", "refunded", "scheduled" verbatim. This violates CLAUDE.md golden rule #7 (all user-facing copy goes through messages/en.json) and is inconsistent with the rest of the app: the customer account page already defines a localized status map (app/(customer)/account/page.tsx PAY_STATUS → account.payAuthorized/payCaptured/...), and components/provider/PayoutsTable.tsx / customer/UpcomingBookings.tsx render StatusBadge with localized labels via ternaries. The new code re-invents tone lookup maps but skips the label localization those patterns provide. Note also the trivial local `Badge` wrapper around StatusBadge adds nothing — other tables pass children directly to StatusBadge.

content.text:
The verification is complete and conclusive. The finding is a real, actionable issue.

Confirmed facts:
- `components/admin/AdminActivityTables.tsx` lines 69, 74, 79 render `label={r.status}` — the raw DB enum value (`in_progress`, `captured`, `authorized`, `refunded`, `scheduled`, etc.) shown verbatim to the admin user. These are the only three places in `components/` and `app/` that render a raw status string as a label.
- This violates CLAUDE.md golden rule #7 (all user-facing copy through `messages/en.json`).
- Localized equivalents already exist in `messages/en.json`: `payAuthorized`/`payCaptured`/`payRefunded`/`payFailed` (lines 475-478), `payoutScheduled`/`payoutPaid` (195-196), and session-status labels `statusCompleted`/`statusInProgress`/`statusCancelled` (433-435). So the strings to map to are already present; the component just skips the label localization.
- The inconsistency claim holds: the customer account page (`app/(customer)/account/page.tsx` lines 89-97, 202-216) uses a `PAY_STATUS` map with both `labelKey` and `tone`, rendering `{t(pay.labelKey)}`; and `components/provider/PayoutsTable.tsx` lines 37-47 renders localized labels via a ternary. The admin tables re-invent the tone-only lookup and omit the label localization those patterns provide.
- The `Badge` wrapper (lines 50-52) is a trivial pass-through to `StatusBadge` that adds nothing other tables don't already get by passing children directly.

One nuance worth noting for whoever fixes it: the cleanest fix mirrors the existing `PAY_STATUS` pattern by combining `tone` + `labelKey` into one map per table (rather than tone-only maps plus a separate label lookup), which also lets the trivial `Badge` wrapper be dropped in favor of `StatusBadge` directly.

input.reason: Confirmed real and actionable. In components/admin/AdminActivityTables.tsx, the three status columns (lines 69, 74, 79) render render: (r) => <Badge tone={...} label={r.status} />, passing the raw DB enum value as the user-facing label. Admin users therefore see developer strings verbatim ("in_progress", "captured", "authorized", "refunded", "scheduled", "paid", etc.). This violates CLAUDE.md golden rule #7 (all user-facing copy must go through messages/en.json). Grep confirms these are the ONLY three places in components/ and app/ that render a raw status string as a label. The inconsistency claim is verified against the codebase: app/(customer)/account/page.tsx (lines 89-97, 202-216) uses a PAY_STATUS map carrying a labelKey and renders {t(pay.labelKey)}; components/provider/PayoutsTable.tsx (lines 37-47) renders localized labels via a ternary using t("provider.payoutPaid")/t("provider.payoutScheduled"). Localized strings for every status the admin tables display already exist in messages/en.json — payAuthorized/payCaptured/payRefunded/payFailed (475-478), payoutScheduled/payoutPaid (195-196), and statusCompleted/statusInProgress/statusCancelled (433-435) — so the fix is just mapping enums to those keys (ideally folding tone+labelKey into one map per the existing PAY_STATUS pattern and dropping the trivial local Badge pass-through wrapper). The finding's pointers are all accurate; the only minor caveat is that the leak is to an admin-only screen, so user impact is limited, but it is still a genuine i18n/consistency defect worth fixing before merge.
